messages:
alex: FYI getting multiple customer p99 reports since ~02:17 UTC, large spike on chat-prod. p95 also nudged up. Root looks correlated to last-night compileflag change.
priya: oncall here, grabbing traces and request IDs. which flag was flipped?
alex: ATTEN_SELECT_HEURISTIC=sdpa_prefer enabled in canary at 01:50 UTC, rolled to 30% at 02:00. spikes start ~02:17, exactly when canary crossed certain hosts.
deploy-bot: deploy canary 2026-03-14T01:50 by @lisa (flags: ATTEN_SELECT_HEURISTIC=sdpa_prefer).
marco: thanks. initial hunch: SDPA kernel path may be slower for our long-context chat shards (seq>4096) on A100s due to new compile flags. need repro. alex can you paste a sample request id?
alex: req=chat-prod:0f9a3b2c, sample payload length ~6k tokens, timeline: server queuing 12ms, kernel exec 380ms vs baseline 120ms. logs: `kernel=sdpa_v2 compiled_with=FAST_REDUCE=true`
lisa: we tested locally with seq512 and got benefit, but didn't run long-context CI. my bad.
hannah: can we revert the flag on canary immediately while we investigate? risk to throughput but reduces customer impact.
marco: we can flip canary back to heuristic=flash_fallback in ~5m. prefer do that first then gather perf traces across affected hosts.
priya: doing the toggle now. @ops-bot please patch canary flag and escalate to prod rollback if needed.
ops-bot: ack. issuing flag toggle: ATTEN_SELECT_HEURISTIC=flash_pref on canary cluster. Expected completion ~5m.
marco: also capture nvprof traces and kernel counters when we flip. add telemetry key `attn.kernel.latency.sdpa_v2` on those hosts.
lisa: repro steps I’m running: docker image r-infer:canary -> run model=redwood-chat-8k with batch=1 seq=6k, cc: `python bench_attn.py --model redwood-chat --seq 6144 --batch 1 --profile`. sharing results in ~10m.
alex: attaching minimal logs for req 0f9a3b2c: `TRACE req=0f9a3b2c host=gpu-14 kernel=sdpa_v2 exec=379.8ms memcpy=12ms kv_lookup=5ms`
marco: looks like exec time dominated, likely worse kernel selection for long KV sizes. possible regress in block-scheduling or reduction kernel when FAST_REDUCE=true.
hannah: if toggle reduces p99 we can schedule full rollback. canary toggle should show effect in ~10m on metrics. alert on p99 > 200ms.
priya: metrics are already trending down after ops-bot toggle. p99 back to baseline for the canary slice in dashboards.
lisa: my local repro confirms: sdpa_v2 is +3x vs flash for seq>5k on this GPU firmware. adding repro logs to the ticket.
marco: next steps: 1) hold rollout and roll back flag on all canary hosts (in progress), 2) open kernel regression PR to remove FAST_REDUCE or add fallback heuristic, 3) add automatic hysteresis to heuristic so we prefer flash for seq>2048 until kernel validated.
alex: also create a customer-facing status note summarizing cause and mitigation. I'll draft.
priya: filing postmortem checklist and capturing affected customers and billing impact.
lisa: opened issue #IR-1422 with repro + nvprof traces + machine types.
marco: I'll start a hotfix branch to add runtime switch: if seq_length > 2048 AND kv_size>X => force flash path. quick revert patch to be reviewed.
hannah: schedule a small canary for hotfix, then slow rollout once perf validated. also update runbooks with temp mitigation.
alex: thanks team. keep updates short here, paste metric snapshots and PR links as they appear. :thumbsup:
priya: monitoring shows p99 stable now. leaving oncall but will wake if it deviates.
marco: PR 5478 opened: runtime: heuristic hysteresis + guarded FAST_REDUCE toggle. linking in channel.
ops-bot: flag rollback to all canary hosts completed at 02:38 UTC.
marco: closing loop: add automated perf job for seq values [512, 2048, 4096, 6144] to CI matrix to avoid regressions like this.
lisa: will add tests and run overnight.
alex: customer status note: "investigating latency regression after internal kernel flag change, temporary rollback applied, working on guarded fix and broader tests.""
